key_insight: Data-visibility, a structural property of the forcing data rather than a smoothness condition, helps establish when adaptive least-squares finite element methods converge linearly and achieve optimal rates.
engineering_relevance: The framework covers linear elasticity and other PDE systems, supporting adaptive simulation with computable residual-based error bounds.
method: Formulate the PDE as a linear isomorphism from a Hilbert trial space to an L2-type residual space.
Use the L2 residual, uniformly equivalent to trial-space error, for reliable and efficient error estimation.
Analyze Dörfler-marked mesh refinement using the new data-visibility property.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a theoretical convergence framework but reports no numerical benchmarks or quantitative performance results.
watch_item: Convergence guarantees are conditional; applicability requires checking data-visibility and the framework’s operator assumptions.
paper_title: Convergence of Adaptive Least Squares Finite Element Methods
